name: portfolio
description: Full-stack portfolio monorepo with public frontend, admin dashboard, and backend API.

scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@portfolio/frontend
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=@portfolio/admin
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=@portfolio/backend
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:shared && npm run build:db
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:db && npm run test:admin && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin && npm run build:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:shared && npm run lint:db && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:admin && npm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:db && npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:admin && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:assets && npm run check:deployment && npm run check:release && npm run build
